title: Spectacular Seville overview
text: An incredible overview of beautiful Seville with a combination of short walks and being driven in a luxury van.  Manuel, our guide, was a wealth of information and a very interesting and engaging gentleman.  Juan Carlos, our driver, somehow navigated the narrow streets and hairpin turns with ease.  We left with a great sense of the history and importance of Seville and Andalusia and highly recommend this tour for a small private group, even if it is a bit of a splurge.
author: PhiladelphiaPhillip

title: Wonderful tour around town…
text: Great experience.  Having the private van allowed us to see more of this large city.  Enjoyed the sights and personalized attention.  Recommended.
author: Anthony_D

title: Highly Recommended for Overview of Seville
text: Our guide was phenomenal.  She had a deep knowledge and passion for the history of Seville.  The driver was did a perfect job of getting us close to sights and assisting our elderly parents in getting in and out.  I highly recommend this experience for people who want to get a good overview of the city who want to limit their walking.
author: Deborah_G

title: Seville discovered
text: This was the perfect tour!!  Our guide was fantastic and she showed us so much history being from Sevilla.  She knew great history, unique places, and balanced a solid pace of waking and driving to the next beautiful location!!  It was perfect!!
author: Jeanne_D

title: Montserrat sightseeing with Jordi
text: Jordi was a great guide. He explained everything with a lot of clarity and passion for the subject. He was very accommodating for one member of our party who needed help walking. He made sure we saw the choir at Montserrat which was a really special experience.
author: Swati_S

title: Comfortable walking & driving tour in Sevilla
text: Elana was a great your guide!  Spoke very good English and taught us a lot about the city & history of Sevilla and Spain. Highly recommend!
author: Bill_H

title: Great way to see the sights and beat the heat!
text: We were traveling with my older parents, who have reduced mobility, and this tour was a perfect way to get around the town and see its beauty! We were traveling in June, so some heat was to be expected, but it was a great way to take a 'rest day' with walking but still see Seville!
author: Leigh_A
